title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Connection Management Work Item
summary: Add DoQ client-side connection management: idle timeout helpers, connection reuse safety check, explicit DOQ_NO_ERROR close, and in-progress transaction tracking.
planned_changes:
- Add SuggestedIdleTimeout constant and EnsureIdleTimeout helper to DoqDefaults.
- Add IdleTimeoutMargin property, last-activity tracking, active query counter, and connection-failure flag to DoqClient.
- Add reuse-safety check in QueryAsync that throws if idle time is too close to the effective timeout.
- Add DOQ_NO_ERROR explicit close in DisposeAsync when outstanding queries exist.
- Surface ConnectionFailed exception for in-progress queries when the connection fails.
- Add focused tests: connection reuse when healthy, rejection when too close to idle timeout, DOQ_NO_ERROR close, and abandoned query surface.
verification_plan: Run DoQ stream lifecycle tests, DoQ foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Usage profiles or fallback to TCP/TLS (slice 0016).
completion_notes: All 11 REQs are now traced and verified. The DoQ client manages connection lifecycle, idle timeout, and in-progress query abandonment.
